problem_type: Real decoder fixture requires an unrelated optional encoder
symptom: The entire real image decode suite fails before running on Mac FFmpeg distributions without libwebp
direct_cause: WebP test creation incorrectly assumes the packaged decoder also contains a WebP encoder
class_root: A real decode test must use a real encoder without coupling that encoder to optional codecs in the tested decoder distribution
affected_population: Every real image decoder test on a build without the optional WebP encoder
internal_only_reason: This is the Nomi internal split between candidate ownership and authored timeline state; provider documentation cannot decide it
invariants: Real WebP bytes are generated with an existing standard Chromium encoder
The actual bundled FFmpeg decoder and every positive/negative decode assertion still execute

door_reduction.why_not: The existing fixture owner remains the only encoder composition

generality_proof: Fixtures use a real encoder independently of the decoder build; no test is skipped and production decoding is unchanged

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Generate real JPEG and PNG bytes and keep WebP generation independent of optional FFmpeg encoders

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Real Chromium encodes the existing real PNG into WebP

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: a real %s decodes with real dimensions
same_class_entry_points.evidence: The existing real WebP dimensions and negative fixtures continue through the actual decoder

recurrence.reason: Every full run fails on a decoder build without the encoder
same_class_scan: Original clean v0.23.1 repeats the missing WebP encoder failure
Both bundled and system FFmpeg expose PNG/JPEG but no WebP encoder

prevention.invariant: Actual decode tests do not require optional FFmpeg WebP encoding
prevention.failure_mode: Encoding or decoding rejects the fixture and fails the suite
prevention.strategy: Compose existing Chromium encoding with existing FFmpeg decoding

legacy_paths.rationale: New web transport keeps the existing runtime contract; there is no alternate legacy collector

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The application owns source windows and generation completion policy

migration: No source data or production media runtime change

invariant_owner_layer.why: The fixture owner has the actual class regression tests
